author: xkcd's What If?
description:
Get a copy of What If? 2 and Randall’s other books at: https://xkcd.com/books
More serious answers to absurd questions at: https://what-if.xkcd.com/

This question comes from Raga, who asks: since rainbows are caused by the refraction of sunlight by tiny droplets of water, what would a rainbow look like if we had two suns like Tatooine?

A planet with double suns would have double rainbows. Or rather, quadruple rainbows.
